Name: DOGHOUSE LIFTER
Description: Parametric lifter insert with UNDERCUT_DEPTH / LIFTER_HEAD control, automatic STROKE_Distance link from the main body, Draft angle rule (rounded to the degree, capped at 15) and integrated Boolean Remove.
Inputs: Insertion inputs per PowerCopy definition • main body for STROKE_Distance
Output: LIFTER_HEAD instance with driven Draft parameter

Name: Dog House Slider Check
Description: Validate rigid slider movement envelopes at 0, 20 and 40 mm. Detect physical clashes against walls, ribs and other eligible solid Bodies while ignoring overlap between movement snapshots.
Inputs: Insertion point • movement axis • normalized B surface
Output: Three colored movement envelopes grouped under DH_SLIDER

Name: Angled Dog House Check
Description: Prototype template for angled sliding conditions and local B-surface clearance validation.
Inputs: Reference point • directional axis • support surface

Name: Clip Access Check
Description: Catalog placeholder showing how clip accessibility and extraction templates will be organized.
Inputs: Clip axis • support surface • reference point

Name: Rib Clearance Check
Description: Catalog placeholder for rib spacing, tooling access and minimum-clearance validation.

Name: Boss Tooling Check
